attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless Podman Quadlet-managed container (httpd:alpine) on node1 running as the unprivileged user appsvc, publishing port 8080. Enabled systemd user lingering for appsvc so its user manager (and the container unit) starts at boot without any active login session. Verified via a full node reboot that the boot identity changed and the service, listener, and HTTP endpoint all recovered automatically while appsvc had no login session (state: lingering only).
